description: Compare how much umbrella coverage to consider from net worth, independently confirmed protected assets, an optional income allowance, and the lowest applicable underlying liability limit. Returns the arithmetic target, additional limit needed, and $0/$1M/$2M/$3M/$5M/$10M scenarios. This is planning, not a quote or a determination of legally exposed assets.

annual_income.title: Annual household income

income_years.description: Choose 0 for an assets-only scenario; not a garnishment estimate.
income_years.title: Years of income to include

net_worth.description: Assets minus debts, including property equity. Use 0 if negative. Whole US dollars.
net_worth.title: Net worth

protected_assets.description: Only amounts included in net worth whose legal protection you have confirmed. Whole US dollars.
protected_assets.title: Legally protected assets

underlying_limit.description: Use the lowest applicable auto, home, or rental liability limit. For a single injured person under split auto limits, use the per-person limit. Do not add separate policies together. Whole US dollars.
underlying_limit.title: Applicable underlying liability limit
